name: Schema.org PublicationIssue
description: Adds Schema.org/PublicationIssue to the JSON-LD output.
project_description:
This module provides the Schema.org/PublicationIssue integration in Drupal Schema.org Metatag module.

 Requirements 
 
 Schema.org Metatag module. 
 
 Usage 
 
 Enable the schema_publication_issue module on Administration > Extend page. 
 Go to Administration > Configuration > Search and metadata > Metatag > tab Settings ( /admin/config/search/metatag/settings ), select the required Content Type (CT) and check the "Schema.org: PublicationIssue" checkbox (screenshot). 
 Select your entity type and bundle, expand the " Schema.org: PublicationIssue " fieldset and fill in the field mappings you want to publish.
